revisions.change_summary: Description of change: Replace all FileHold references with Silq eQMS equivalents, update supplier assessment frequency requirements from fixed intervals to risk-based language with documented justification aligned to supplier criticality, add requirement to document risk justification when selecting Category I or Category III self-assessment frequency and update all "21 CFR 820 Quality System Regulation" citations Reason for change: DC.SLQ002; IA-2025 mNC #4, OFI #4 and OFI #8.
